## [architecture.md](architecture.md): DevAgent architecture (63 lines)

UI, workers, alarm receivers and widget share one in-process AgentRepository StateFlow. WorkManager runs batched jobs, AlarmManager runs reminders, Glance renders the widget.

## [data.md](data.md): DevAgent stored state (46 lines)

All state is one AgentState in filesDir/agent_state.json, written via temp file and rename. A file that fails to parse is silently replaced by defaults.

Settings tab controls headline hour (8), nudge hour (20), check interval (60 min), feeds and keywords. Manifest permissions cover network, notifications, boot and exact alarms.

## [operations.md](operations.md): Building and running DevAgent (56 lines)

Build with ./build.sh from WSL (debug APK copied to D:\android_projects), install with ./build.sh install over adb. Battery Unrestricted is needed on Xiaomi, Samsung and OnePlus.
